text: SUPERVISOR DISPATCH — REBUILDNOTIFY-0606. New feature ordered by the user, verbatim: "someone needs to make a notification system in the app that overlays and says i need to rebuild the bundle. i bet thats the floor problem but idk how it is but we will see. there is a rebuild to do". The failure this kills: a change lands that hot reload CANNOT deliver (engine/native/wire-format change — today's example: a physics wire-layout change shipped to JS while the running engine predated it, so the world floor silently vanished and the user fell forever with zero explanation). The app must TELL the user the running bundle is stale and a rebuild is needed — an in-app overlay notification, not a console line. Steps: 1. SURVEY FIRST — find what overlay/toast/notification chrome already exists in the runtime and what the dev server (cli/commands/dev.ts — note it carries uncommitted changes, disk is truth) already knows about engine vs bundle versions. Compose with what exists; do not build a parallel one-off. 2. Detection: the dev/hot-reload pipeline must know when a change requires a rebuild beyond hot reload (engine/native .zig change, wire-format/header bump — find the real signal, e.g. engine hash/build id mismatch between what the running session loaded and what is on disk). The signal must be the REAL thing, not an mtime guess that false-positives. 3. Overlay: when stale, the running app shows a persistent, unmissable overlay notification: rebuild needed (say what kind). It clears when the rebuilt bundle is loaded. Respect the three chrome laws (no wrap orphans, conditional sections, no duplicate controls). 4. Make it a notification SYSTEM only as far as the overlay channel is reusable — the rebuild-needed notice is the first consumer; do not gold-plate beyond that. 5. Prove at the consumption layer: simulate the stale condition and capture the overlay via SELFSHOT (tools/rjit shot — full image path in your report, never a bare filename). Build via tools/rjit only; never revert anything; saves hot-reload into the user's live session so keep states coherent. DONE-BAR: tools/rjit game verify green + SELFSHOT of the overlay showing under a simulated stale-engine condition + READY report with the detection signal you used. DO NOT COMMIT. Do not shrink or stub any file. Only the user's live confirmation makes this a PASS.
